overclaims: Intercom's account describes useful production delegation, which challenges an absolute dismissal of autonomous work.
checks.note: The excerpt, proposition, May 2026 period, axis, horizon and unresolved outcome all match. Problem 1: e8 only shows that Fin freed capacity. It does not show autonomous work, so saying it 'challenges an absolute dismissal' overstates it, and 'absolute dismissal' is loaded framing of the speaker. Problem 2: e8's excerpt is cut to 'Fin had freed up significant capacity', which drops the qualifying clause 'the team still played a big role in managing day-to-day support work'. That is a one-sided citation. e9's fragment 'an assumed resolution' says almost nothing on its own.
